newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Foreigners boost Argentine financial assets in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners boost Argentine financial assets in Nov.

text.p: The total value of shares, bonds and other financial assets held by non-residents in Argentina rose by $1.76 billion in November, the National Securities Commission said.
November's figure meant total total holdings by non-residents of financial assets in Argentina rose by 13 percent during the month to $15.3 billion, the Commission said.
The stock of corporate bonds held by non-residents rose by $6.95 million, or 7.61 percent, during the month. The stock of governent bonds rose by $1.57 billion, or 20.6 percent.
The value of shares rose by 3.0 percent, less than the increase in the value of Buenos Aires Stock Exchange's general share index, which rose by six percent.
